title: The sourdough counter
alt: Whole and halved sourdough loaves sit beside a serrated knife in a working bakery.
description: Food photography with crust, open crumb, flour and layered natural materials.
prompt: A beautiful food-editorial still life in a working bakery: one complete round sourdough loaf beside a second loaf cut cleanly in half, exposing irregular open crumb. A serrated bread knife rests flat on the board, separated from the bread. Flour dust, a linen towel, a proofing basket and a tray of baked loaves form a richly layered but orderly scene. Natural early-morning side light, crisp crust texture, believable food shapes, no hands, people or writing.
